name: THE END Credits
summary: Turn travel footage into a 16:9 end-credits roll: THE END types in, the credits scroll up while your clips play in a small window, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Requires Panel runScript and Draft authoring; no extra tools to install (no Homebrew, Node.js or ffmpeg): music previews, your own music and in-shot motion use the ffmpeg bundled with Selects. Windows is built to the kit rules but not yet verified on a real Windows machine.
